insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3 Cr (plan-wise). Family First: Base individual SI 1L to 15L + floater SI as per formula (plan-wise).

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
great.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 12 months from the policy start date. After 1 year, claims for these conditions become payable, which is better than the common 24-month wait.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Medical expenses related to the hospitalization are covered for up to 90 days before admission. This helps pay for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to hospitalization.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy..
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. Claims for PEDs start only after you complete 2 years on the policy.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: An additional refill amount up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured is provided once the base sum insured is used. This gives extra coverage for subsequent claims in the same policy year.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days from the policy start date, but accidents are covered immediately. This is a standard market waiting period.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to the hospitalization are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment costs like medicines, tests, and consultations.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Room rent is covered up to the Sum Insured, but Suite (or above) category rooms are excluded. Choosing a non-suite room helps avoid room-rent related restrictions on your claim.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured applicable under the Policy by 10% of the Base Sum Insured ... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum insured increases by 10% of the Base Sum Insured for each continuous claim-free year, up to a maximum of 100%. This can meaningfully increase your available cover over time without paying extra premium.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization expenses are covered, but only on a reimbursement basis. You may need to pay first and then submit documents to get the claim amount back.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) special condition
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered up to the Sum Insured, but some robotic surgeries have a sub-limit of Rs. 1 Lac. This can reduce payout if you undergo a high-cost robotic procedure.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks, and various kits are listed as not covered. These items can create significant out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room rent Option 1: Rs 3,000 per day or Shared Room; whichever is lower Option 2: Rs 5,000 per day or Single Private Room; whichever is lower
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Family First variant – Silver)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at Rs 3,000/day (shared) or Rs 5,000/day (single private), whichever is lower for the chosen option. A room-rent cap can lead to higher personal payment and may also trigger proportionate deductions in related hospital bills.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: A limit of maximum INR 1 Lac will apply to all robotic surgeries, except the following...
bad.reference: Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) – Special condition applicable for robotic surgeries
bad.explanation: Robotic surgeries are capped at a maximum of INR 1 Lac (with some exceptions). This is a procedure-wise sub-limit that can leave a large shortfall on expensive surgeries.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
bad.explanation: A co-payment can be applied on the amount payable by the insurer (the percentage is not stated here). If co-pay applies to your plan/schedule, you will have to bear that share of every claim, which increases out-of-pocket costs.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
